title: Suite 3 of T-495's claimable half: the Shell Layout Spec v2 single-chat-entry rules rewritten from a source-text scanner into render assertions, and the already-behavioural top-nav suite wired
scope: One suite, because T-495's acceptance is per suite. The other rows of the T-492 draw are untouched and keep their T-492 verdicts.
The GATED half of T-495 -- the rows carrying textIsTheSubject -- is not touched here. Two of them live in src/__tests__/hygiene, which this change leaves unwired even though it is now green.
This record exists so the T-770 control resolves the deleted path's classification from the LATEST record rather than from the T-492 draw.
method: Re-verified on origin/main a8ef8aed4b by RUNNING the suite: 19 cases, 1 failed -- the byte assertion that topbar-nav-items.ts contains label: "Knowledge", which a deliberate nav rename removed.

Measured what the 18 passing cases were worth before rewriting anything. Its 'ProgramDetailPage imports AtlasDrawer' case passed only because a CODE COMMENT in ProgramDetailPage.tsx names AtlasDrawer; the page renders AtlasDrawer through AgentCanvas and no case checked that it still does. Its surface lists were filtered through existsSync, so IntelligenceIndexPage, since deleted, left the suite with no failure. The only listed surface importing AgentColumn, SourceIndexPage, is mounted by no route. And it knew only AgentColumn and AskAnythingBar, so the AgentDock that Tower renders was never counted.
The byte assertions were DELETED rather than repaired, per the acceptance.

The replacement renders each surface a route mounts -- ProgramDetailPage, ProgramsIndexPage, TowerCommandCenterAvaShell, SetupPoliciesPage, SetupAuditPage -- with every chat-entry leaf (AgentDock, AgentColumn, AskAnythingBar, AtlasDrawer) replaced by a sentinel, and asserts the exact list of chat entries each renders. The Atlas page-state provider is wrapped rather than replaced, so the surfaces still receive real context and each mount is countable. AppShell is rendered directly for the provider and legacy-rail rules.

The Rule 5 nav cases were not re-asserted: src/components/navigation/__tests__/NexusTopNav.test.tsx already asserts both by render (the product nav renders with no showProductNav prop; the six current labels, and no Knowledge or Learn), 17 of 17 green, and it ran in no workflow. Its directory is wired as a directory in the same change.

suites.rationale: Nineteen cases over the bytes of six surface files plus AppShell, NexusTopNav and topbar-nav-items. Red on the base for a deliberate nav rename. Of the eighteen green cases, one passed on a comment, the surface lists silently shrank through existsSync, and the chat component the most-used surface actually renders was outside its vocabulary. The classification is set false here because the file no longer exists.
suites.sourceTextScannerNote: false because the path is gone, not because its content was reclassified. T-770 resolves classification by path and filters its live set by existsSync, so this row lowers the live declared-scanner count by one.

suites.rationale: Reads no repository file. The directory was already run by the AI surface control catalog workflow's 'Exercise unwired component suites' step, so placing the suite there wires it with no workflow change.
Unchanged. It already renders NexusTopNav and asserts the two nav rules the deleted suite held as byte scans; it simply ran nowhere.
